protocol.A: operating price-factor model (F35 own returns, F11 ATLAS52 proxy, F36 residual GARCH)
protocol.B: same architecture plus DFII10 and DEXKOUS levels; coefficients and factor acceptance chosen only on inner training dates before each block
protocol.training: refit and reselect before each 20-origin block; coefficients frozen within block
protocol.primaryError: mean over origin dates of mean over 52 stocks x 20 horizons of |p50 - actual| / actual x 100
protocol.rankHits: sum over origin dates of |top5 predicted 20-session return ∩ top5 actual|, max 600
protocol.rankTies: return descending then stock code ascending
protocol.adoption: B error < A error AND B rank hits >= A rank hits; and data-quality gate (point-in-time vintage, corporate actions) must also pass

reasons: macro series are current-vintage retrievals; 7-day publication lag is an assumption
price adjustments and corporate actions unverified

errorDifferenceBminusA.note: origin days overlap in target windows; sd is descriptive, not an independent-sample standard error
